course_name: 進階英文閱讀與聽講練習
outline: 教導學生閱讀囊括全球議題的文章，並藉由文章的內容作技巧的訓練，字彙的建構，語言的解析，及思維的啟發。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
schedule:
1	Introduction
2&3	The Power of Double-speaking, p. 7
4&5	Traveler’s Tales, p 17
6&7	International Travelers Shouldn’t Miss…, p. 29
8	Review
9	Mid-term Proficiency Test
10&11	Spotlight on: East Asian Movies Head West, p. 39
12&13	Strike the Pose in Tokyo, p. 51
14-16	Time to Legalize?, p. 61
17	Review
18	Final Proficiency Test
assessment:
presentation	10%
Mid-term Exam (campus wide)	15%	Week 9
Final Exam (campus wide)	15%	Week 18
Mid-term Exam/Final exam	14/14=28%
Homework (including essay)	10%
In class assignment (including quizzes)	22%
